_meta.status: APPROVED for the MVP by Person A on 18 October 2026 (approximate values, not exported from Figma)
_meta.source: Pixel colors sampled from PNG screenshots of the 2023 desktop designs (home, All Items, listing detail, header states, two modals). Screenshots are compressed, so hex values can be off by a few units.
notToTrust: Font family is a visual guess (looks like Poppins).
No spacing, radius, type scale, shadow, or breakpoint values were measured.
No mobile frames were seen, so mobile values are unknown.
_meta.nextStep: If Figma access becomes available, export the real variables and replace the values in app/globals.css.
notes: A second, brighter orange (#FB7800) appears on the Confirm buttons in both modals. It is not a token for now. Revisit when the Figma values are available.

approval.scope: The sampled colors (brand primary #E55910), brand-strong #C2410C for small orange text and buttons, and the system font stack, as mapped in app/globals.css.
approval.replaceWhen: Real Figma values become available; only app/globals.css needs to change.

primary.source: Nav links, Lend button, section accents
primary.decision: Chosen as the brand primary by Person A.
primary.note: Hero uses a semi-transparent orange overlay over a photo (about #DE6934 on screen); treat that as an overlay, not a token.

sans.value: system font stack (ui-sans-serif, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial)
sans.note: The design looks like Poppins, but that was never confirmed. Switch the stack in app/globals.css if it is.

contrastChecks.note: WCAG 2.1 AA needs 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text or UI components.

results.aa: fails for normal text, passes for large text

contrastChecks.suggestion: Adopted: #C2410C (brand-strong, 5.18:1 with white, both directions) is used for small orange text and buttons with small white text. Approved by Person A on 18 October 2026.
